recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; it restores the final FHIR-44612 clarification in the intended ElementDefinition field without reverting later Medication.definition changes.
issue_request: FHIR-44612 was an Applied/Persuasive Pharmacy change request asking to add a comment to Medication.definition: "This element can be used to help with Cross Border use cases and separately it may also be useful if someone needs to drill into more medication specific information."
initial_application: The issue was first applied by commit 6d0749117049c7fa6fb16a79c611f932eb34d4e7, which appended the requested wording to the Medication.definition definition text instead of adding an ElementDefinition comment.
additional_context: Medication is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied issue FHIR-46414 changed Medication.definition from MedicationKnowledge to definitional resources and replaced the short and definition text, which explains why the appended FHIR-44612 wording disappeared. Pharmacy WG minutes from January 2024 record the cross-border Medication.definition rationale and a 5-0-0 approval.
reconciliation: Added the requested wording as a <comment> on Medication.definition in source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml, preserving the later FHIR-46414 definition and target profiles.
source_changes: source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml: added the FHIR-44612 Cross Border/drill-down guidance as the Medication.definition comment.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied issue changed Medication.definition short, definition, and target profiles; it explains the missing wording but did not supersede the requested comment.
